name: @ikliml666/dsh-codewiki
description: Repository-level code-wiki compiler for DeepSeek Harness: turns a whole repo into cross-linked Markdown articles under .codewiki/ with a sidebar panel for progress, engine logs and per-stage model settings. Incremental by design, with an article contract gate before anything reaches disk. Default channel drives the upstream FSoft-AI4Code/CodeWiki Python engine (needs a local Python 3.10+ venv with closed deps); a minimal built-in Node channel remains for hosts that cannot run it.
